ndcg.name: NDCG_inverse_MSE_v1
ndcg.relevance: g(d)=1/(1+d), d>=0 normalized delta-last aligned future MSE
ndcg.ideal: same valid support sorted increasing future MSE
ndcg.tie: stable inherited support order: P100 stored ID order; FULL canonical bank ID order
ndcg.legacy_metric: Do not reuse legacy NDCG name or claim parity if transform differs

ranking.kendall_full: APPROXIMATE tau-b from 4096 fixed future-free candidate pairs per query/channel, seed0; report unique pair count and tie exclusions
ranking.full_global_spearman: exact average ranks on one query/channel score vector at a time; streaming candidate vectors may spill to local disk

regret.inequality_domain: Rfull<=Rp100<=Rmodel applies ONLY to model selected inside that same P100
regret.full_model: For Full-selected model assert Rfull<=Rmodel only; never require Rp100<=Rmodel

full_scoring.global_softmax: exact global per-head logsumexp across all eligible candidates, then mean probabilities; no per-chunk softmax
full_scoring.full_oracle: stream all valid candidates, exact running Top10; no query/channel/candidate pruning

probe.implementation: streaming Ridge regression only; fixed alphas [0.1,1,10]
probe.full_train_candidate_sample: 100 eligible IDs uniformly sampled without replacement per query/channel; seed0; no future selection
probe.evaluation: ALL validation/test queries, channels and candidates in evaluation support
probe.selection_objective: mean validation future-MSE regression error over all eligible candidate pairs

statistics.channels: resample all channels of each query time jointly

scheduler.pending_gpu: Existing48-run controller has exclusive major GPU use; new diagnostic inference not launched until it is complete and free-GPU check passes

legacy_ndcg.name: legacy_shifted_negative_MSE
legacy_ndcg.policy: reproduce legacy metric only for canonical gate; separately report NDCG_inverse_MSE_v1

baseline_numerics.period: at least two cycles; otherwise undefined
baseline_numerics.historical_full_v0: raw cosine TopK (single-slot legacy argmax); preserve FP tie behavior
baseline_numerics.full_v5: canonical global per-head softmax mean, never per-chunk softmax
